text: Hi, my name is Rohan Mehta (rohan.m@example.com). Round 1 was an online assessment: a sliding window array question and a tree BFS problem. Round 2: interviewer asked me to design an LRU cache and kept pushing on the time complexity of each operation. Then 20 minutes on Leadership Principles, ownership story using STAR. Got the offer.
